description: WRITE through any operation in the MakeHybrid manifest that changes something -- 280 of them (477 MakeHybrid API): sending a message, publishing a post, commenting, reacting, inviting, moving a task. This tool refuses every GET; read with makehybrid_read. Documented in MakeHybrid's own API reference at /linkedin-docs.html. Use makehybrid_list_operations to find the operation id and makehybrid_describe_operation to see its parameters, then call it here. Authentication is handled by the server.

body.description: JSON request body, for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE operations only. Omit it for GET.

operation.description: The operation id from makehybrid_list_operations (e.g. "get_v1_accounts"), or "METHOD /path" (e.g. "POST /complete/v2/{account_id}/posts"). A "plan:" prefix here overrides the plan argument.

path_params.description: Values for the {placeholders} in the operation path, by name, e.g. {"account_id":"acc_123"}. Every placeholder is required; values are URL-escaped for you, so pass them raw.

plan.description: Which MakeHybrid plan: complete = MakeHybrid API (/linkedin). complete is the full LinkedIn surface, billed per seat (one LinkedIn account each) after a 30-day trial.

query.description: Query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings; null and undefined entries are dropped.

name: makehybrid_write
title: MakeHybrid: send, post and change
